name: 파르셀
scene: On a frozen coastal basalt platform beneath pale morning light, composed upright standing card pose with face toward camera, both empty hands relaxed open and separated from her torso.

One tiny pearl hair clip, no crown, no armored spikes or institutional emblems.

casual.scene: At an empty indoor bouldering gym in warm afternoon light, standing grounded on a thick safety mat beneath a wall of colored holds, rubbing a small amount of climbing chalk between two separately visible hands at waist height. Low camera angle, complete body and shoes, no suspended pose.
casual.outfit: Opaque plum sleeveless athletic tank with secure high neckline and high-waisted silver-gray fitted climbing shorts, flat climbing shoes; bare arms shoulders and legs, tiny pearl bracelet, no harness or armor.

casual.scene: At a shaded open-air garden kitchen in late summer morning, standing side-on and scooping violet berry sorbet into a glass dessert dish with one hand while the other steadies the dish on the countertop. Face in profile, both hands readable, bright fruit and leafy dappled light.
